summary: C-J1 (FS-GG/.github#4710) binds the Coordination managed-group owner, pinned at (FS-GG/FS.GG.Coordination, ac22206560f3eddfea524ce8f752ff1d0dfeec4e, eng/managed_group_owner.py, sha256 d846dbe1..., 45315 bytes), into the inline caller of the fable-reference-public.yml job wasm-installed-c. The caller fetches the owner through its closed acquisition path, checks size and SHA-256 before import, then checks the contract and the owner's self-hash. It probes containment before provisioning and qualifies actual tool versions under the setup deadline. Every call is one require-empty run under one never-renewed phase deadline, with a fresh out_dir under the job root. Executables are identity-bound with a recorded basis, and the hashes of declared script inputs (validator, checker) are retained per group. The job's Python runs in a sudo systemd-run delegated unit with TasksMax/MemoryMax hard limits. Installed C is wired per invocation. The shell checker's --mode wasm prepares only the downloaded source and production graph and runs no browser. The caller's installed_c runs that checker as one group, then each family's Playwright --list and test invocation as its own group, and applies the 9-case list and result assertions per family. The browser host validator is content-addressed, so its hash is in the profile argv. Lessons: the supplier refuses control characters in argv; a test should validate every real call site against the real validate_profile at run time; cwd must lie inside the profile root; and a nested owner inside a leaf cannot work (the root would not be exclusive), so Playwright must be launched from the top-level owner. The WASM receiver targets published Workspace.Template 0.19.1. Still held: both steps (if: false), main() (RUNTIME_ADMITTED=False) and custody_gate before installed C; installed-c.json records failed with its first cause. A non-required PR probe established hosted containment of tiny commands only. Not established: the Chromium support/runtime join, the three-family custody pilot, stock shutdown under require-empty, WebKit, the 27-case journey, and provenance of installer-output and host images.
title: Held installed-WASM caller binds fsgg.managed-group-contract/1 with one group per Playwright invocation
